$comment: Focus Buddy message bank v1.0 (Day 04). Placeholders: {task}≤40 {objective}≤60 {nextStep}≤80 {lastTitle}≤60 {words}≤60 chars, truncated with … by the formatter; also {host} {timeLeft} {time} {minutes} {planned} {actual} {focused} {count} {awayMin}. *.generic variants are used when Private notifications is on. Every notification string that uses {task} has a .generic sibling (lint-enforced).

messages.start.title: Focus session started
messages.start.body: {task} for {planned}. Tab titles are checked on this computer until you stop.
messages.start.body.generic: Tab titles are checked on this computer until you stop.
nudge.l1: Looks like we've drifted away from {task}. Ready to continue?
Still with {task}? This tab doesn't look related.
Quick check-in: is this tab part of {task}?
nudge.l1.generic: Quick check-in: is this tab part of your session?
This tab doesn't look related to your session. Ready to continue?
messages.nudge.repeat: Still away from {task}. Come back whenever you're ready.
messages.nudge.repeat.generic: Your session is still here whenever you're ready.
messages.alert.l2.title: Time to head back?
messages.alert.l2.body.generic: Your session is waiting when you are.
messages.overlay.title: Back to {task}?
messages.overlay.body: This tab doesn't look like part of your session. Pick what fits.
messages.overlay.countdown: Take a breath. All buttons work now.
messages.relevant.confirm: Done. {host} pages with “{words}” now count as part of {task}.
messages.break.shortened: Your session ends at {time}, so this break will be shorter.
messages.break.over.title: Break's over?
messages.break.over.body: Ready to get back to {task}? Or take a few more minutes.
messages.break.over.body.generic: Ready to get back to your session? Or take a few more minutes.
messages.continue.title: Continue your session?
messages.continue.body: Focus Buddy paused while you were away. Nothing was checked.
messages.continue.panel: You were away for about {awayMin} min, so {task} was paused. Nothing was checked while paused. {timeLeft} left.
messages.mute.on: Sounds and full-page reminders are off until {time}. Quiet check-ins continue.
messages.extend.capped: Sessions can be up to 8 hours, so this one now ends at {time}.
messages.session.alreadyActive: A session is already running: {task}. Keep it, or end it and start this one?
messages.session.replace: End it and start this one
messages.parse.durationDefaulted: We couldn't find a length, so we set 60 minutes. Change it if you like.
messages.parse.durationClamped: Sessions can be up to 8 hours, so we set 480 minutes.
messages.parse.untilPassed: That time has already passed today. How long do you want to work?
messages.parse.durationConflict: We found more than one length, so we used the first one. Change it if you like.
messages.parse.durationClampedMin: Sessions start at 5 minutes, so we set 5 minutes.
messages.parse.durationMissing: We're not sure which time you meant. How long do you want to work?
messages.parse.siteSensitiveSkipped: We left out a private site. You can add any site here by hand.
messages.parse.siteUnrecognised: One word looked like a web address, but we couldn't use it. Add the site by hand.
messages.parse.sitesTruncated: A session can hold 50 sites, so we kept the first 50.
messages.parse.objectiveMissing: What will be done by the end? A goal helps us word your check-ins.
messages.parse.objectiveTruncated: Your goal was long, so we shortened it. Edit it if you like.
messages.parse.labelTruncated: The task name was long, so we shortened it. Edit it if you like.
messages.parse.labelFallback: We weren't sure what to call this task. Give it a name that suits you.
messages.parse.keywordsTruncated: We kept the first 12 keywords. Add or remove any of them.
messages.parse.safeDraft: We couldn't read much from that sentence, so here is a plain session. Fill in the rest.
messages.summary.title: Session complete
messages.summary.time: You planned {planned} and spent {actual}. About {focused} was on task.
messages.summary.away: Idle or away: {minutes} min. This is part of session time.
messages.status.unsure: Not sure about this tab. That's fine.
messages.status.idle: Idle. Nothing is checked until you are back.
messages.status.unfocused: Chrome isn't in front. Nothing to check.
messages.notice.notifications_unavailable: Notifications aren't showing, so check-ins will appear here and on the toolbar icon.
messages.notice.overlay_permission_missing: Full-page reminders need permission to show on websites. Using notifications instead.
messages.notice.overlay_unavailable_page: Full-page reminders can't show on this kind of page, so a notification was used.
messages.notice.storage_error: Focus Buddy couldn't save something. Your session is still running.
messages.notice.prefs_reset: Some settings couldn't be read, so they were reset to defaults.
messages.notice.safe_mode: Focus Buddy hit a problem reading its data and is running in safe mode. Your settings are unchanged.
messages.privacy.neverSaved: Tab titles and page addresses are never saved. Words you pick for “This is relevant” last one session, unless you tick Remember.
messages.delete.confirm: This deletes all sessions, history and remembered pages on this computer.
messages.delete.done: All Focus Buddy data on this computer was deleted.
messages.overlay.muteChooser: Mute sounds and full-page reminders for
messages.relevant.title: Count this as part of your session?
messages.relevant.host: Everything on {host} will count as part of {task}.
messages.relevant.words: Pages on {host} whose title contains these words will count:
messages.relevant.wordsHelp: Shorter words match more pages. Kept until this session ends, or saved if you tick Remember.
messages.relevant.confirmHost: Done. {host} now counts as part of {task}.
messages.relevant.notAvailable: This was a private site, so there's nothing to allow.
messages.mute.off: Sounds and full-page reminders are back on.
messages.tooltip.none: Focus Buddy: no session. Click to open.
messages.tooltip.awaitingContinue: Session paused while you were away. Click to continue.
messages.confirm.title: Check your session
messages.confirm.help: Change anything that doesn't look right.
messages.intervention.closeHint: You can close this tab at any time.
messages.onboarding.seen.question: Did you see it?
messages.onboarding.seen.yes: Good. Check-ins can show as notifications.
messages.onboarding.seen.no: Until it's fixed, check-ins will show in the side panel and on the toolbar icon.
messages.settings.overlayDenied: Chrome didn't give permission, so full-page reminders stay off. Check-ins will use notifications instead.
messages.settings.incognitoHelp: Chrome must also allow Focus Buddy in incognito. Private-window titles are never saved.
messages.delete.title: Delete all data?
messages.delete.sessionRunning: Your running session will be ended first.
messages.delete.resetWarning: Resetting also clears your own private-site list, so those sites would be checked again.
messages.delete.doneReset: All data was deleted and settings were reset to defaults.
messages.nudge.title: Focus Buddy
messages.settings.siteAccessRemoved: Website access removed. Full-page reminders are off.
messages.mute.shortcut.rest: Muted and paused for the rest of this session.
messages.overlay.relevantHandoff: Opening a page where you can choose which videos count.
